limitations: Repeated use of the same training people: target refresh, not new-person learning each round.
Reset final adapters receive one round of gradients; trajectories consume cumulative compute.
Continuous frozen controls have continuous LR schedules; continued branch restarts optimizer/scheduler, so the comparison does not perfectly isolate target refresh.
Three seeds and fixed evaluation split; seed t intervals assume normal seed effects.
Mean confidence on errors is conditional on a changing error set; also inspect common-error matched items.
Gold used for diagnosis only; no performance-based round selection.
Stop after exp11 and make a stage decision before exp12.
